name: host-javascript-subscription-order-and-runtime-instances
reason: The locally inspected headless command interface exposes data writes/dumps and advance, but no JS callback registration, unsubscribe, instance factory, bind or batch callback operation. Native idle changed flags remain true for 5 scalar paths, so those flags cannot establish callback drain counts or order. Direct probes additionally reject image/font/list property writes and data-create/data-bind commands; these cannot faithfully compare the host asset/list/factory API.
coveredInstead: Independent Anima subscription/batching script and Chromium/Firefox separate-bundle tests; exact native scalar writes and final trigger-listener values compared separately.
